WORM'S-EYE FROM GROUND — camera flat against scorched concrete looking straight up as the skyship's blade-hull eclipses the entire upper frame, exhaust-cone venting white plasma, a silhouetted figure sprinting below barely clears the shadow's leading edge.

OVER-THE-WING POV — camera locked on the port blade-wing's leading edge as the skyship screams toward a burning target-spire, wing dominating the lower frame in riveted black steel, horizon tilting forty degrees, cloud-deck scrolling beneath at terrifying speed.

COCKPIT-CANOPY PURSUIT — looking through scratched forward canopy at a fleeing skyship banking left through a storm-wall, reticle glowing amber at frame-center, instrument-haze reflected on the glass, lightning illuminating the target's contrail half a second ahead.

GOD'S-EYE FROM HIGHER ALTITUDE — camera far above looking down at the skyship threading between two cloud-layers, ground only visible as a pale patchwork through a lower cloud-break, the ship reduced to a dark needle trailing twin white lines toward vanishing point.

THROUGH-CLOUD-LAYER BREAK — skyship punching upward through a storm-deck, upper hull bursting into sunlit open sky while the lower stern still churns gray vapor, shockwave-cone flaring off the prow, golden light splitting the cloud-tear in radiant shafts.

MOUNTAIN-PASS THREADING — skyship banking hard through a granite choke-point, snow-capped peaks filling both vertical edges of frame, blade-wings clearing rock faces by meters, contrails curling into the pass behind, altitude-marker altimeter spinning wildly at frame-corner.

LOW-PASS OVER MEGACITY — rooftop-level camera shaking from downwash as the skyship roars past tower-tops, neon advertisement panels shattering from pressure-wave, hull-plating catching amber dusk-light, the ship gone to a speck in two seconds leaving debris raining below.

CHEEK-TO-CHEEK PARALLEL — camera riding air at matched velocity beside the skyship, hull filling the entire right half of frame from razored prow to engine-stern, twin contrails braiding behind, a distant carrier-airship sits tiny at the left vanishing point.

FORMATION-FLYBY — camera ahead and low, leading three skyships in arrow-formation, exhaust-trails from the lead ships braiding into a triple helix overhead, sun directly behind the formation turning all three hulls into black silhouettes against blinding white light.

DOGFIGHT-BANK PURSUIT — camera fixed on the skyship as it wrenches into a ninety-degree bank through dense cumulus, wingtip motion-blur smearing the cloud-wall, a missile-flare igniting from the starboard mount, a target contrail spiraling out of frame bottom-right.

CARRIER-LAUNCH DEPLOYMENT — skyship dropping free from a mothership-class carrier that fills the upper frame like a descending ceiling, ship falling into open atmosphere below, smaller escort vessels already circling at mid-altitude, sun-shafts cutting between the two hulls.

ATMOSPHERIC RE-ENTRY BURN — skyship slicing down through upper atmosphere trailing a white-hot plasma-sheet, thermal-shield at the prow glowing amber-to-white, burn-trail scoring the sky above, ground still seventy kilometers below shimmering through the plasma-distortion lens-ripple.

VERTICAL CLIMB — camera below looking up the skyship's centerline as it claws straight up through three stacked cloud-layers, exhaust-cone building a vapor-pillar directly at the lens, sun a blinding disc dead ahead at the climb's apex, smaller ships receding below.

DIVE-BOMB DESCENT — camera tracking the skyship in a near-vertical plunge, ground target growing fast in lower frame, weapon-mounts along the belly charging visibly blue-white, hull vibrating in motion-blur, debris already rising from a previous strike to meet the ship.

HOVER-OVER-WASTELAND — skyship locked motionless above a ruined settlement, massive hull dominating the upper two-thirds of frame, downwash spiraling dust into a visible vortex below, armed ground figures looking up, circling escort ships tiny at the distant cloud-line.

UNDER-THE-BELLY PASS — camera directly beneath as the skyship slides overhead, weapon-mounts, cooling vents, and launch-tubes filling the frame's ceiling, hull-plating edge-lit by sun at the stern, ground traffic visible in motion-blur at frame-bottom rushing past below.

TILT-BACK FROM SHADOW — camera on a hilltop suddenly dropped into moving shadow, the skyship's hull silhouette blocking the sun overhead, ground crew shielding eyes as the ship's rim catches hard edge-light, the shadow's leading edge racing across cracked earth below.

ABOVE THE CLOUD-DECK PIERCE — wide aerial at cloud-bank altitude, skyship cutting upward through the cloud-floor with upper hull bathed in gold and lower half still buried in gray shadow, two escort ships cresting the cloud-line on either flank.

THROUGH-DEBRIS-CLOUD WEAVE — camera tracking the skyship threading through a tumbling debris field, chunks of burning hull-plate spinning past the lens, the ship banking hard left then right, a fireball glowing in the deep background, lens-flare washing the right edge orange.

OVER-THE-SHOULDER FROM TOWER — tiny pilot figure in foreground silhouette on a tower-top, skyship filling the midground at full terrifying scale crossing left-to-right, pilot's coat whipping in the downwash, the ground far below the tower visible in vertiginous depth behind.

COCKPIT CANOPY-POV PURSUIT — looking through scratched forward canopy glass at a fleeing skyship banking hard left, targeting reticle pulsing amber at frame-edge, instrument-panel glow bleeding onto the canopy interior, horizon tilting violently as altitude bleeds away below.

ABOVE THE CLOUD DECK PIERCE — wide aerial framing at cloud-bank altitude, skyship puncturing the deck from below, upper hull in blazing gold sunlight, lower third still submerged in cloud-gray shadow, two escort ships visible at the cloud-line edge.

OVER-THE-SHOULDER FROM PILOT — tiny pilot silhouette in sharp foreground standing atop a communications tower, skyship passing at mid-frame in full scale, scale-contrast brutal and immediate, engine-glow painting the pilot's suit from behind, horizon dropping away at distance.

VERTICAL DROP FROM BRIDGE — camera at the skyship's prow-bridge looking straight down through a floor-glass panel, ground three kilometers below perfectly visible, another ship far below like a toy, the horizon curve perceptible at the frame's upper edge.

CANYON-FLOOR RUN — camera mounted at canyon-floor level looking forward as the skyship roars through at wall-grazing speed, sheer rock walls framing the shot in tight vertical slabs, pebbles and dust ripped upward by the pressure-wave, sky a narrow ribbon above.

CONTRAIL-FRAME WIDE — camera far behind and high, skyship reduced to a dark needle at the center of a contrail-cross etched across a deep-blue sky, the contrails spreading wide to both frame-edges, altitude implied entirely through the emptiness surrounding the ship.

COCKPIT-CANOPY POV — looking through forward canopy glass at a fleeing target skyship banking left across a blood-orange dusk horizon, targeting reticle pulsing red at frame-center, instrument-glow washing the canopy interior amber, sun-glare slashing across the top edge of the glass.

LOW-PASS OVER CITY — camera at rooftop-parapet level as the skyship screams past tower-tops, downwash visible shredding awnings and debris off ledges below, hull-glow reflecting in a thousand tower windows simultaneously, neon signage smearing across the belly-plating, the gap between hull and rooftop barely breathable.
